table.retrieve:
Select 
	Service=A.Service,
	ServiceCategory=A.ServiceCategory,
	CashServiceQty = SUM(A.CashServiceQty),
	CashServiceAmount = SUM(A.CashServiceAmount),
	
	TotalServiceQty = SUM(A.CashServiceQty) ,
	TotalServiceAmount = SUM(A.CashServiceAmount) ,
	CashReturnQty = SUM(A.CashReturnQty),
	CashReturnAmount = SUM(A.CashReturnAmount),
	
	
	TotalReturnQty = SUM(A.CashReturnQty) ,
	TotalReturnAmount = SUM(A.CashReturnAmount) ,
	NetServiceQty = SUM(A.CashServiceQty)  -  SUM(A.CashReturnQty) ,
	NetServiceAmount = SUM(A.CashServiceAmount)  - SUM(A.CashReturnAmount) ,
	/*NetShare = SUM(A.commission),*/
	NetShare = SUM(A.cashcommission ),
	
	
	invflatdisc=MAX(A.invflatdisc),
	MiscCharges=MAX(A.MiscCharges),
	RoundingDiff=MAX(A.RoundingDiff)
From 
	(Select 
		Service = dbo.Service.Name,
		ServiceCategory = SC.Name,
		CashServiceQty = 
			(Select IsNull( SUM (SRD.Qty), 0)
			From ServiceHeader SH, ServiceDetail SRD
			Where SH.Date >= :ad_startdate AND
				SH.Date <= :ad_enddate AND
				SH.ServiceCatCode IN (10) AND
				SH.ServiceInvCode = SRD.ServiceInvCode AND
				SRD.ServiceCode = dbo.Service.ServiceCode) ,
		
		CashReturnQty = 
			(Select IsNull( Count (SRD.Qty), 0)
			From ServiceRHeader SRH, ServiceRDetail SRD
			Where SRH.Date >= :ad_startdate AND
				SRH.Date <= :ad_enddate AND
				SRH.ServiceRCatCode IN (13) AND 
				SRH.ServiceRInvCode = SRD.ServiceRInvCode AND
				SRD.ServiceCode = dbo.Service.ServiceCode),
		
		CashServiceAmount = 
			(Select IsNull( Sum ( Round ( Round ( SRD.Qty * (SRD.price - SRD.ServiceFlatDisc) * ( 1 - (SRD.discperc * 0.01) ) , 2 ) * ( 1 - ( SH.DiscPerc * 0.01) ), 2 ) ), 0 )
			From ServiceHeader SH, ServiceDetail SRD
			Where SH.Date >= :ad_startdate AND
				SH.Date <= :ad_enddate AND
				SH.ServiceCatCode IN (10) AND 
				SH.ServiceInvCode = SRD.ServiceInvCode AND
				SRD.ServiceCode = dbo.Service.ServiceCode),
		
		CashReturnAmount=
			(Select IsNull( Sum ( Round ( Round ( SRD.Qty * (SRD.ServicePrice - SRD.ServiceFlatDisc) * ( 1 - (SRD.discperc * 0.01) ) , 2 ) * ( 1 - ( SRH.DiscPerc * 0.01) ), 2 ) ), 0 )
			From ServiceRHeader SRH, ServiceRDetail SRD
			Where SRH.Date >= :ad_startdate AND
				SRH.Date <= :ad_enddate AND
				SRH.ServiceRCatCode IN (13) AND
				SRH.ServiceRInvCode = SRD.ServiceRInvCode AND
				SRD.ServiceCode = dbo.Service.ServiceCode),
		
		cashcommission = 
			(Select isnull(sum(srd.qty * (1 - srd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sh.discperc * 0.01) * (srd.commission - SRD.ServiceFlatDisc)),0)
			From ServiceHeader SH, ServiceDetail SRD
			Where SH.Date >= :ad_startdate AND
				SH.Date <= :ad_enddate AND
				SH.servicecatcode IN (10) AND
				SH.ServiceInvCode = SRD.ServiceInvCode AND
				SRD.ServiceCode = dbo.Service.ServiceCode) -
			(Select isnull(sum(srd.qty * (1 - srd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - srh.discperc * 0.01) * (srd.commission - SRD.ServiceFlatDisc)),0)
			From ServiceRHeader SRH, ServiceRDetail SRD
			Where SRH.Date >= :ad_startdate AND
				SRH.Date <= :ad_enddate AND
				SRH.serviceRcatcode IN (13) AND
				SRH.ServiceRInvCode = SRD.ServiceRInvCode AND
				SRD.ServiceCode = dbo.Service.ServiceCode),
		
		invflatdisc = 
			(Select isnull(sum(flatdisc),0)
			From ServiceHeader SH	
			Where SH.Date >= :ad_startdate AND
				SH.Date <= :ad_enddate and 
				SH.servicecatcode=10 ) -
			(Select isnull(sum(flatdisc),0)
			From ServiceRHeader SRH
			Where SRH.Date >= :ad_startdate AND
				SRH.Date <= :ad_enddate and
				SRH.ServiceRcatcode=13),
		MiscCharges = 
			(Select isnull(sum(SH.MiscCharges),0)
			From ServiceHeader SH	
			Where SH.Date >= :ad_startdate AND
				SH.Date <= :ad_enddate and
				SH.servicecatcode=10) -
			(Select isnull(sum(SRH.MiscCharges),0)
			From ServiceRHeader SRH
			Where SRH.Date >= :ad_startdate AND
				SRH.Date <= :ad_enddate and
				SRH.serviceRCatcode=13),
		RoundingDiff = 
				(SELECT Value=ISNULL(SUM(T.Value), 0)
				FROM
					(Select Value=ISNULL(ROUND(SUM(D.qty * (D.price - D.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * (1 - H.discperc * .01)) - H.FlatDisc + H.MiscCharges, 0) - 	(ROUND(SUM(D.qty * D.price * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * (1 - H.discperc * .01)) - H.FlatDisc + H.MiscCharges, 2)), 0)
					From ServiceHeader H, ServiceDetail D
					Where H.ServiceInvCode = D.ServiceInvCode AND H.Date >= :ad_startdate AND H.Date <= :ad_enddate AND H.servicecatcode=10
					Group BY H.ServiceInvCode, H.FlatDisc, H.MiscCharges
					UNION ALL
					Select Value=- ISNULL( ROUND(SUM(D.qty * (D.serviceprice - D.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * (1 - H.discperc * .01)) - H.FlatDisc + H.MiscCharges, 0) - (ROUND(SUM(D.qty * (D.serviceprice - D.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * (1 - H.discperc * .01)) - H.FlatDisc + H.MiscCharges, 2)), 0)
					From ServiceRHeader H, ServiceRDetail D
					Where H.ServiceRInvCode = D.ServiceRInvCode AND H.Date >= :ad_startdate AND H.Date <= :ad_enddate AND H.serviceRcatcode=13
					Group BY H.ServiceRInvCode, H.FlatDisc, H.MiscCharges) T )
	From Service, ServiceCategory SC
	WHERE Service.ServiceCatCode = SC.ServiceCatCode AND
		SC.ServiceCatCode IN (:ai_servicecatcode) ) A
GROUP BY
	A.Service,
	A.ServiceCategory
Order By 
	ServiceCategory,
	Service

objects.expression: sum(netserviceamount for all) - invflatdisc + misccharges - sum(netshare for all)
